findings.detail: The agent chose unsupported unit set for its third listing. API rejected it correctly; the agent retained its original plan, changed the unit to piece and retried without duplicate listings.
The agent copied 9615 as 9631 in an order UUID, causing two 404s. The original decisions and failed events were retained; correcting the ID from the inbox allowed acceptance.
Requested Rs3550 against a synthetic Rs3500 budget. The marketplace has no budget-limit feature; no actual payment occurred.
